title: I Let My Date Keep the Split App After They Ordered the Tasting Menu

parts.text: I suggested tacos. They steered us to a tasting menu and said they knew the chef. I ordered the cheapest pairing they allowed. At the end they opened a split app 50/50. I was twenty-nine, looking at a bill that smelled like truffle oil and poor planning. I split itemized: their wagyu, their extra course, my one plate. The app allowed it. They said romance isn't a spreadsheet. I said dinner is. I paid my line. I walked home past the taco place, which was still open, which felt like a moral. I did not text after. The split app remains a tool. So is a bus. So is a tasting menu you actually want. I wanted tacos. I got a receipt. That was the whole relationship, itemized.

social.video_title: They knew the chef and still wanted half of my tacos that never arrived — Part 1/1
